whySwitch.title: Why brand teams move from Madgicx to Cluega AI

items.title: Commercial semantics, not creative variants
items.body: The ceiling on variant generation is yesterday's creative library. Cluega AI starts from commercial semantics: what this product's core selling point is, which funnel layer this audience sits in, which narrative each market responds to — and only then decides the visuals and the script. What comes out isn't an image that "looks like a winner", it's a creative that "names the pain".

items.title: Being able to look up competitor creative vs. automatically seeing the market turn
items.body: Madgicx's Meta ad library genuinely lets you search advertisers and save the creatives you like — but that's manual browsing: you have to look it up yourself and judge for yourself which narrative is scaling, and you only ever see Meta. Cluega AI integrates the global TikTok and Meta ad libraries and continuously scans the competitors and categories you nominate: new creatives going live, narrative angles shifting, buying intensity rising or falling are all detected automatically into insights that feed straight into commercial-semantic generation — the difference isn't whether there's an ad library, it's whether the insight requires you to sit and watch for it.

items.title: Whether a creative is good is decided by the sale
items.body: A high-CTR creative doesn't necessarily close. Cluega wires private-domain IM attribution down to creative granularity: which creative brought a conversation that moved to lead capture, order and payment — visible the whole way. For the first time a brand team can iterate creative strategy on "sales" rather than "clicks".

items.title: A complete loop from creative to media buying
items.body: After Madgicx produces a creative, launching, testing and iterating still fall to people. Cluega AI's fully managed L4 (autonomous AI buying tier) joins creative generation, launch, budget allocation and retirement into one line; AAIGS tiering decides how much autonomy the AI has, and performance data flows automatically into the next round of generation.

pancake.body: You buy Meta only with budget concentrated on a single platform, what you need is automated account health checks, creative performance analysis, manual creative research in the Meta ad library and fast variants of existing assets, and your team already has stable creative output.

cluega.label: Choose Cluega AI

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you might want to know before you reach out to our team.

items.q: How is commercial-semantic creative different from ordinary AI image generation?
items.a: Ordinary AI image generation answers "what to draw"; commercial-semantic creative first answers "why we sell it this way" — selling point, audience stage and local context come first, then the model produces the visuals and the script, and afterwards every creative can validate that semantic hypothesis against private-domain sales data.

items.q: Can we specify which model to use?
items.a: Yes. Auto routing picks the most cost-effective model by default, and you can also pin a specific model (say Veo for video, FLUX for images); credits are deducted back from cost, so pricier models deduct more, and the billing structure stays transparent.

Self-serve mode is billed in credits (1 credit＝$0.001); in fully managed mode creative is included in the revenue share — every $1,000 of managed ad spend includes a fair-use allowance of roughly 3 short videos + 30 images, with overage at cost, so day to day you never feel it.

Cluega AI continuously scans the global TikTok and Meta ad libraries, tracking the competitors and category keywords you nominate: new creatives going live, narrative angles shifting, buying intensity rising or falling are all detected automatically and formed into insights that serve directly as input to the next round of commercial-semantic generation — no one has to sit and mine the library by hand.

items.q: We already have a design team — how do they fit in?
items.a: The common pattern is to let the design team define brand semantics and layout boundaries while Cluega AI handles production at scale and validation through buying; the best-performing directions then go back to the design team for polish, with people and machines each doing the half they're good at.
